verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly positions itself as a runtime control layer for AI and manages AgentControl configs, so letting it consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents LaunchDarkly's own MCP server (local and hosted), which external AI clients like Cursor or Claude Code connect to. That is the server role and does not show LaunchDarkly can plug in or call MCP servers as a client.
